title: Making Room for the Tide
transcript: When a coastal field is returned to the sea, the first thing we need to know is how high the ground lies. At our trial site, we marked the lowest parts with wooden stakes so that we could find them again after flooding. The tide entered through a narrow opening in the old embankment. To see what the incoming water carried, we placed sediment traps beside the main channel. We also left one corner behind a temporary fence to compare plant growth where cattle could no longer graze. By autumn, the biggest surprise was that seedlings appeared first on raised patches, even though the lower ground received more sediment. Those patches drained sooner after each tide. For the next site, we would therefore map how long water stays on the ground before deciding where to encourage plant establishment.

questions.prompt: The lowest ground was marked with wooden ____.
questions.explanation: 研究人员用木桩标记最低处，以便涨潮后重新定位。

questions.prompt: The team placed sediment ____ beside the main channel.
questions.explanation: 研究人员在主水道旁放置沉积物捕集器，观察潮水带来的物质。

questions.prompt: Cattle were kept out of one comparison area with a temporary ____.
questions.explanation: 研究人员用临时围栏阻止牛进入一角，以比较植物生长情况。

options: On lower ground with greater sediment deposits
On elevated areas that drained sooner
Along the edge of the opening in the embankment
questions.answer: On elevated areas that drained sooner
questions.explanation: 幼苗最先出现在潮水退去后排水较快的高处。

questions.prompt: What would the team assess before choosing planting areas at another site?
options: How far cattle travel while grazing
How wide the main channel becomes
How long the ground remains covered by water
questions.answer: How long the ground remains covered by water
questions.explanation: 讲者建议先绘制积水持续时间分布，再决定在哪里促进植物定植。
